changelog:
Initial release of skill-distillation

- Introduces methods and toolchains for extracting reusable Agent Skills from large models, experts, and books.
- Defines the core Skill structure (Condition, Policy, Termination, Reusable Interface).
- Explains three levels of distillation precision and their applicability.
- Highlights representative open-source projects: SkillAlchemy, Nuwa-Skill, and Cangjie-Skill, with usage instructions.
- Shares key insights on skill integration effectiveness and coverage.
summary: Skill蒸馏 — 从大模型/人类专家/书本中提取可复用Agent技能的方法论与工具链
